Other values

From design-system/tokens.css. Primitive is a raw value; semantic names a job and points at one. The resolved value, and each ink's contrast against --bg-page / --bg-surface, are read by the browser in the theme chosen in the top bar (WCAG 1.4.3: 4.5:1 body text, 3:1 large text and UI). dark marks a token the dark build redraws.
